text: Nice that you have many size options but You have to have a covering made for it.. Don’t know how I missed it...but this comes without any covering at all. The material holding the stuffing together you would not want to sleep on. If Amazon is going to sell these you should be able to buy a cover for it.

product_metadata.title: Pillowflex Bolster Pillow - 8" x 46" - Plush Polyester-Filled Insert for Decorative Shams - Comes in a Poly-Cotton Shell - Odorless, Lint, and Dust-Free, No Lumps Stuffing for Pillows (White, Round)
features: SIZING: Please use the pink sizing charts shown in the images to select the best size pillow inserts for your bolster sham. This insert has a diameter of 8" (8" wide/tall) by 46" long. Please measure your shams when flat. Order the same sham insert to have full looking and firm-to-the-touch bolster pillow! Give your home's shams a touch of class that will last for years.

MADE FOR HOME DÉCOR:  We offer this bolster pillow insert made of 100% Polyester fiber filling to complete your home's interior decoration.  Though filled full, this pillow is not intended for your support while exercising.  This stuffing for pillows is odorless and free of flame-retardant chemicals, dust, or lint. While not designed for yoga use, these plush soft inserts can revive your shams.

ULTIMATE IN SOFTNESS: Just like our square and rectangular polyester-filled sham stuffing, these bolster inserts are also comfortable to hold and use. The slick polyester fiber resists lumping while providing a great loft. Use this pillow insert anywhere in your home that may need a pillow… couch, love seat, beds, day beds, or reading nook. You may use it as a neck roll and sleep on it.

POLY-COTTON COVERING: A USA-Made shell or cover crafted from poly-cotton fabric holds the polyester pillow stuffing. Useful for indoor living areas, these products are easy to clean. Our small bolsters are machine washable, while the longer bolsters are recommended for spot cleaning.

MADE IN USA: We support American manufacturing and hope you do too. Our super soft and plush pillow inserts are proudly made in Palmetto, GA. We use sustainably sourced fiber and materials. We also make our own polyester-cotton blend shell to give you ready-to-use pillow choices for decoration, sleeping, resting, cuddling, or even playing.
